messages:
marta: incident-bot just created an incident for serving-usw2: repeated CUDA OOMs on gpu-pool-3 despite reported headroom. some pods restarting. tagging oncall @aj :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident #1792005678 created: gpu-oom-headroom-reclaim-race. Severity: high. Channels: #incidents, paging to @oncall.
aj: I’m on it. grabbing logs from the failing pod. any customer hits yet?
sasha: seeing p50->p99 latency spike around 12:07UTC, error rate ~8% for model-route /v1/generate. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panelId=812&from=now-15m
kevin: kubectl logs show repeated allocator messages then CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY. paste of recent tail:
```
2026-03-15T12:06:21Z allocator: reserve_blocks=4 reserved_bytes=268435456 free_headroom=1213483008
2026-03-15T12:06:21Z kvcache: evicting 4 entries (shard=7)
2026-03-15T12:06:21Z runtime: cuda_call: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: attempted allocation 536870912
2026-03-15T12:06:21Z allocator: fragmentation detected: free_chunks=[64MB,128MB,32MB,96MB] total_free=320MB
2026-03-15T12:06:22Z pod: container restart count=3
```
kevin: headroom metric (prometheus) shows ~1.1GB available but allocator failing to find contiguous chunk -> fragmentation/Reserved-block reclaim race?
chris: this smells like reserved-blocks fragmentation. I saw a similar pattern when KV cache reclaim wasn't synchronous with allocator reclaim. we might need to force KV cache flush + compact reservation.
julia: which customers are affected? ops-bot, can you pull recent 5xx traces grouped by customer?
ops-bot: Recent 5xx (12:00-12:10UTC): acme-analytics: 230 errors, blueboard: 78 errors, internal-ci: 12 errors. Total impacted ~3.2k requests.
aj: switching traffic for route /v1/generate to model-1-small fallback (canary) now to reduce memory footprint. running: rdctl traffic split --route /v1/generate --to model-1-small=0.4
sasha: good. also lowering concurrency on the pool to avoid large growing KV cache per request: patching config: `max_concurrency: 8` -> `4`
kevin: trying a live mitigation on one node: echo flush command to daemon: `rd-allocator --node gpu-09 --compact-reservations`
kevin: output:
```
compact: scanning reservations... reclaimed 192MB from stale kvcache entries
compact: coalesced adjacent free blocks -> created contiguous 256MB chunk
allocator: retrying allocations from pending queue... success 6/8
```
marta: did that reduce restarts?
kevin: on gpu-09 restarts stopped, error rate decreased. but other nodes still flapping.
chris: let's run a global KV cache flush + enable aggressive reclaim for 10m. config change in runtime configmap: `allocator.reclaim.strategy: aggressive` and `kvcache.flush=true` applied via k8s rollout.
julia: notifying support: sending initial customer impact note to customers impacted, referencing incident id, estimated mitigation steps.
aj: paging infra for possible node-level memory defragmentation from the kernel (echoing to driver) and to prepare spare nodes to shift pods. @oncall-ml can you coordinate shifting sensitive customers?
oncall-ml: reallocating high-SLA customers to reserved pool in us-east-1. initiating pod drain on 3 nodes in affected AZ.
incident-bot: Update: mitigation in progress — traffic shifted, allocator config updated, kvcache flush initiated. Monitoring for 15m.
sasha: note from runtime logs after global changes:
```
2026-03-15T12:09:03Z allocator: aggressive_reclaim enabled
2026-03-15T12:09:04Z kvcache: flush completed shard=0..15 freed=412MB
2026-03-15T12:09:06Z allocator: compacted reservations; created contiguous blocks >=256MB
2026-03-15T12:09:07Z runtime: allocation queue drained, OOM count -> 0
```
aj: error rate down to ~0.6% and p95 latency returning to normal on patched routes. still watching.
kevin: keeping a watch for recurrence. need a postmortem item list: reproduce locally, add allocator metric for largest_contiguous_free, add auto-compact on threshold, examine KV cache eviction sync, consider reducing reservation granularity.
marta: agreed. Julia, please get a short customer-facing update. we'll leave incident open until stable for 30m.
julia: drafting message, pinging account owners of acme-analytics and blueboard with mitigation summary and ETA for RCA.
chris: thumbs. also propose we add an alert for contiguous_free_bytes < X% of headroom so we don't rely solely on total_free headroom.
incident-bot: Incident #1792005678 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update in 15m.
marta: thanks all — great quick work. assigning follow-up to eng-runtime (kevin, chris, sasha) for RCA.
kevin: adding OW ticket: RUNTIME-1723 "allocator: fragmentation causing OOM despite headroom"
aj: wrapping up: handoff to afternoon oncall. @oncall-ml you're up. leaving thread. :white_check_mark:
